description: The HiWATER consortium groups field, airborne and remote-sensing observations from its 2012 intensive campaign in a named Figshare collection. The public collection API currently lists 85 child item records, while the describing article reports 102 datasets from the broader campaign. The measurements concern an oasis system with a flux observation matrix, ecological sensors, ground surveys and airborne products. A modeller can select child records to check irrigation-water, land-surface or crop-environment simulations across scales. A caveat is that this collection is an index, not a single harmonized table: each child deposit has its own variables, formats, coverage and rights. Licence: CC-BY-4.0, read from the DataCite record of its DOI on 2026-09-28; obtaining it is free of charge. I read the own collection metadata and child list without downloading data, checking every child's licence or asserting that all 102 article datasets are present here. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
